# pdecompR: Partial Differential Equations and Finite-Element Computing in R

***pdecompR*** is an R-native framework for defining, discretizing,
solving and analyzing partial differential equations with the
finite-element method. Its design follows the path

**geometry, mesh, finite-element space, weak form, assembly, solver,
solution, error estimation, sensitivity, optimization**,

in the spirit of [FEniCSx](https://fenicsproject.org) and
[Gridap.jl](https://github.com/gridap/Gridap.jl), but everything runs in
R: there is no Python, no Julia and no compiled code. Sparse linear
algebra comes from the
[Matrix](https://cran.r-project.org/package=Matrix) package (CHOLMOD and
sparse LU).

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("adamrsophie/pdecompR")
```

## Quick start

Solve `-Laplace(u) = f` on the unit square with `u = 0` on the boundary,
where `f` is chosen so that `u = sin(pi x) sin(pi y)`:

``` r

library(pdecompR)

mesh <- pde_mesh_rectangle(x = c(0, 1), y = c(0, 1), nx = 32, ny = 32)

problem <- poisson_problem(
  mesh = mesh,
  diffusion = 1,
  source = function(x, y) 2 * pi^2 * sin(pi * x) * sin(pi * y),
  boundary = dirichlet_bc(value = 0, marker = "boundary")
)

solution <- solve_pde(problem)
summary(solution)
plot(solution)

exact <- function(x, y) sin(pi * x) * sin(pi * y)
errornorm(solution, exact, "L2")
```

A mesh refinement study confirms the expected orders:

``` r

convergence_study(problem, exact, mesh_sizes = c(8, 16, 32, 64))
```

The same problem in the weak-form language:

``` r

V <- fe_space(mesh, degree = 2)
u <- trial_function(V)
v <- test_function(V)
a <- integrate_domain(dot(grad(u), grad(v)))
f <- function(x, y) 2 * pi^2 * sin(pi * x) * sin(pi * y)
L <- integrate_domain(f * v)
solve_pde(variational_problem(a, L, dirichlet_bc(0)))
```

## What is implemented

| Area | Functionality |
|----|----|
| Geometry and meshes | rectangles and simple polygons; structured meshes (three diagonal patterns); polygon meshes (ear clipping, Delaunay flips, refinement); validation of connectivity, orientation, degeneracy and boundary markers; quality measures; subdomain regions with piecewise coefficients; Gmsh 2.2 and 4.1 import (physical lines and surfaces); VTK export (P1 and quadratic P2 cells, vectors, stresses) |
| Finite elements | continuous Lagrange P1 and P2 on triangles, scalar and vector valued; interpolation, point evaluation, observation matrices |
| Quadrature | Gauss-Legendre on intervals; triangle rules exact to any degree |
| Assembly | sparse triplet assembly of stiffness, mass, advection and boundary matrices, load vectors, constant tensor diffusion |
| Boundary conditions | Dirichlet (by elimination, keeps SPD), Neumann, Robin; pure Neumann problems with compatibility check and zero-mean gauge |
| Linear solvers | sparse Cholesky and LU; preconditioned CG, BiCGSTAB and GMRES; residual diagnostics |
| PDE classes | elliptic (diffusion, advection, reaction), linear elasticity (vector P1/P2, plane strain and stress, stress and von Mises output), SUPG stabilization, heat and parabolic problems (backward Euler, Crank-Nicolson, time-dependent coefficients, mass diagnostics), reaction-diffusion systems (IMEX, Newton), quasilinear diffusion, semilinear reaction, p-Laplacian |
| Weak forms | [`trial_function()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/pdecompR/reference/trial_function.md), [`test_function()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/pdecompR/reference/trial_function.md), [`grad()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/pdecompR/reference/trial_function.md), [`dot()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/pdecompR/reference/trial_function.md), [`integrate_domain()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/pdecompR/reference/trial_function.md), [`integrate_boundary()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/pdecompR/reference/trial_function.md) |
| Verification | L2, H1 and energy errors, convergence studies with observed orders, symbolic manufactured solutions through symcompR, a reference benchmark suite |
| Adaptivity | residual error estimator, Doerfler marking, newest vertex bisection, adaptive loop |
| Inference | discrete forward and adjoint sensitivities, parameter estimation with adjoint gradients, distributed optimal control |

Not available yet: three-dimensional and one-dimensional meshes, holes,
mixed elements (Stokes), discontinuous Galerkin methods, nonlinear weak
forms, adjoints for nonlinear and transient problems, and parallel or
GPU backends.

## Validation

Every solver is verified against analytical solutions in the test suite.
Observed orders on the unit square with `u = sin(pi x) sin(pi y)`:

| Element | meshes    | L2 order   | H1 order   |
|---------|-----------|------------|------------|
| P1      | 8, 16, 32 | 1.97, 1.99 | 0.99, 1.00 |
| P2      | 8, 16, 32 | 2.98, 3.00 | 1.95, 1.99 |

Affine solutions are reproduced to rounding error; Crank-Nicolson and
backward Euler show temporal orders 2 and 1; Newton’s method converges
quadratically on quasilinear problems; adaptive refinement on the
L-shaped domain recovers the optimal rate that uniform refinement loses.

## Related packages

pdecompR belongs to a family of R packages by the same author:
[symcompR](https://github.com/adamrsophie/symcompR) (symbolic
computation), [modelcompR](https://github.com/adamrsophie/modelcompR)
(equation-based modeling), [jaxR](https://github.com/adamrsophie/jaxR)
(differentiable computation), [z3r](https://github.com/adamrsophie/z3r)
(constraint solving) and
[optcompR](https://github.com/adamrsophie/optcompR) (optimization).
pdecompR works on its own; integrations with these packages are planned
and will stay optional.

## License

GPL-3.

  : Computational domains

  : Structured triangular mesh of a rectangle
- [`pde_mesh_polygon()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/pdecompR/reference/pde_mesh_polygon.md)
  : Triangular mesh of a polygon

  : Mesh geometry and quality

  : Mesh size
- [`boundary_markers()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/pdecompR/reference/boundary_markers.md)
  [`boundary_nodes()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/pdecompR/reference/boundary_markers.md)
  : Boundary queries
- [`set_boundary_marker()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/pdecompR/reference/set_boundary_marker.md)
  : Relabel boundary edges
- [`mesh_regions()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/pdecompR/reference/mesh_regions.md)
  [`set_region()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/pdecompR/reference/mesh_regions.md)
  : Subdomains (regions) of a mesh
- [`region_coefficient()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/pdecompR/reference/region_coefficient.md)
  : Piecewise coefficients by region
- [`tensor_coefficient()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/pdecompR/reference/tensor_coefficient.md)
  : Spatially varying diffusion tensors
- [`refine_uniform()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/pdecompR/reference/refine_uniform.md)
  [`refine_mesh()`](https://adamrsophie.github.io/pdecompR/reference/refine_uniform.md)
  : Mesh refinement

  : Read a Gmsh mesh

  : Write a VTK file

  : Write a time series for ParaView
